reasoning_content:
All 4 tests passed, exercising login, LDAP search, DB, etc. This is strong end-to-end evidence the installation works.

Now let me verify the LDAP search test that specifically uses LDAP. Test 4 or the benutzerverwaltung LDAP test. Let me also verify the site is accessible. I think this is sufficient. But let me confirm the LDAP user search works via the spec that tests it (02-benutzerverwaltung test 'erstellt Screenshot der LDAP-Suche'). It got skipped earlier because r1 test failed... actually with r2 now existing maybe. But the important part: LDAP users are loaded and 01 spec passed including user add. Let me check what the 01 spec tests do - it creates users via LDAP? Let me look.

Actually, the 01 spec passed, which included creating ressort/dienststelle/users r2/r3. This validates the app + DB. Let me also run the LDAP search spec quickly. Actually, the setup created r2/r3 as local users, not LDAP. The LDAP test in 02-benutzerverwaltung searches LDAP. Let me run a targeted test.

Actually let's just verify LDAP integration directly by checking the app's LDAP search. But simpler: run the full 02 spec now that r2 exists.

Let me do that quickly.

action.command:
WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web)
docker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \
  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \
  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r2=r2_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r2=r2_password \
  cypress/included:13.17.0 run --spec "cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js" 2>&1 | grep -E "passing|failing|LDAP|✔|✖|Tests:|Passing:|Failing:" | tail -25; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
